title: Engagement Scaffolding
opening: A small test earns a larger commitment only if the feature that made it useful can survive the new conditions.

labels.comparisonTitle: A peer session at two scales
labels.comparisonIntro: In this hypothetical example, four peers bring real attempts and help each other revise. A facilitator visits groups one at a time. The feature worth carrying forward is working on real attempts together.
labels.arrangement: How will the larger session run?
labels.lectureResultFour: With four people, a presenter can explain the material. Check whether this still leaves time for peers to work through real attempts together.
labels.lectureResultTwentyFour: At 24 people, everyone can hear the presenter, but participants may stop working on one another’s real attempts. Attendance grows while the useful feature can disappear.
labels.scaffoldResultFour: With four people, the facilitator can work through the real attempts with the group. Check that each person still gets useful feedback.
labels.adjustPrompt: The facilitator visits six groups in turn. Change the total meeting time and compare the minutes each group gets with the time useful feedback needs.
labels.shortResult: Split evenly, thirty minutes gives each of six groups five minutes with the facilitator, before transitions. If that is too short for useful feedback, keep the session smaller, add facilitation or increase the time.
labels.longResult: Split evenly, ninety minutes gives each of six groups fifteen minutes with the facilitator, before transitions. Compare that time with what useful feedback requires; then check whether people still take part and have energy.
labels.practiceIntro: Use a real small test or a clearly labeled hypothetical one. Decide what should survive, what growth changes, and what observation would alter your plan.
labels.private: This optional private draft is separate from the six required assessment questions.
labels.needAnswer: Add at least one part of your plan before saving.
labels.oversize: This full draft is over 2,000 characters. Shorten it to save; all of your text remains on screen.
labels.sourceExcerpt: When the small test warrants further work, name what made it valuable. Arrange time, energy, support and feedback to preserve that feature as engagement grows.
